# UI: workspace image source (global / own recipe / ready-made image), Start run waits for it; docs ## What to build graph-manager's workspace settings drawer (`apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx`, opened from Workspaces → Settings) lets the user pick the workspace's **sandbox image source**: - **Global recipe**: the image built from Settings → Sandbox. - **Own recipe**: a full copy of the recipe, edited with the shared `RecipeEditor`, with its own Node base image, toolchain checkboxes, snippets, order and extra lines. - **Ready-made image**: the existing image input. The Start run drawer disables **Run in sandbox** while this workspace's own image builds. This slice also updates the README and the wiki page for the whole feature: Node-only default, toolchains, and per-workspace recipes. **What already exists:** - **`RecipeEditor`** (`apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RecipeEditor.tsx`): a controlled component with these props: `{ recipe: SandboxRecipe; toolchains: ToolchainInfo[]; onChange(r); disabled?; testIdPrefix? }`. It renders: - the base input (`

-base`), the extra lines (`

-extra`), the live Dockerfile preview (`

-dockerfile`) and its error (`

-error`), where `

` is the prefix (default `recipe`) - toolchain rows `toolchain-` with `-enabled`, `-edit`, `-snippet`, `-reset`, `-edited`, `-up` and `-down` - The preview comes from `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile`. - **Types** in `src/web/types.ts`: `SandboxRecipe { base; toolchains: { id, enabled, snippet }[]; extraLines }`, `ToolchainInfo { id, name, snippet }`, `SandboxSettings { limits, recipe, defaultRecipe, toolchains, dockerfile, image }`, and `SandboxBuild { state: "idle" | "queued" | "building" | "ready" | "failed"; step?; startedAt?; finishedAt?; error?; log }`. - **`SandboxImage.tsx`** has a `BuildBadge` component (lines near the top), which you can export and reuse, and the log `

` with auto-scroll.
- **Server routes:**
  - `GET /api/settings/sandbox` returns the global recipe and `toolchains`.
  - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/settings` returns `{ sandbox: boolean, source: "global" | "recipe" | "image", image: string | null, recipe: SandboxRecipe | null, dockerfile: string | null, effectiveImage: string }`.
  - `PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings` takes `{ source: "global" }`, `{ source: "image", image }` or `{ source: "recipe", recipe }`, and answers the same view plus `build: SandboxBuild`. It answers 400 `{ error }` for an invalid image or recipe, and 409 `{ error }` while that workspace's build runs.
  - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/build` returns that workspace's `SandboxBuild`.
  - `POST /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/rebuild` answers 202 `{ build }`, 400 when the source isn't `recipe`, and 409 while building.
  - A sandboxed start in a recipe workspace whose image is building answers 409 `the sandbox image of this workspace is building; try again when it is ready`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx`, all 110 lines: the current drawer, with its load effect (lines 19–44), `save` (lines 46–60), `Drawer` footer **Cancel** / **Save** (`workspace-settings-save`), the `workspace-image` input with its hint, and the error `
`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxImage.tsx`, all of it: polling with `BUILD_POLL_MS`, `BuildBadge`, and log auto-scroll. Reuse these; export what you need.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx`:
  - lines 159–222: the sandbox status, polling while building, the workspace settings load, `sandboxOn`, and `sandboxImage = wsSettings?.image || sandboxStatus?.defaultImage`
  - lines 365–400: the switch `start-run-sandbox-toggle`, the reason `start-run-sandbox-reason`, and the image line `start-run-sandbox-image`
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx`, lines 341–400: the drawer tests and `fakeApi({ workspaces, wsImage, wsSettingsError })`. Extend `fakeApi`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx`, lines 193–300: the sandbox tests, `stub(ok, {}, { [STATUS]: …, [SETTINGS]: … })`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css`, and the drawer's styles: find `.ws-settings-form` with `grep -rn "ws-settings" apps/graph-manager/src/web`.
- `apps/graph-manager/README.md`, lines 78–150: the Sandboxed runs section and the sandbox images subsection, which still describes the base + apt packages + extra lines recipe and the old routes table.
- `docs/wiki/features/sandboxes.md`: the decisions table (lines 20–57), Known follow-ups (59+), Code references (70+) and Last updated (91+). `docs/wiki/index.md` already links it.
- `docs/prd/sandbox-toolchains.md`: the spec for this whole feature, with its decisions table. Use it for the docs.

## Patterns to follow

**Drawer layout:**
- **Source picker**: under the title, a `
` with `Sandbox image` and three `` choices. The labels are "Global recipe", "Own recipe" and "Ready-made image".
- **Global recipe** selected: a muted line, "Uses the image built in Settings → Sandbox: " (`workspace-global-image`).
- **Own recipe** selected:
  - ``.
  - The first time **Own recipe** is chosen (the workspace's `recipe` is null), prefill with a deep copy of the global recipe from `GET /api/settings/sandbox`; `toolchains` also comes from that response.
  - A **Copy global again** button (`workspace-copy-global`) replaces the local recipe with a fresh copy of the global one. It doesn't save.
  - Under the editor, the build badge (`workspace-build-state`), the error (`workspace-build-error`), the log (`workspace-build-log`) and a **Rebuild** button (`workspace-rebuild`), which calls `POST /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/rebuild`.
  - These show only when the saved source is `recipe`. Poll `GET /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/build` every `BUILD_POLL_MS` while it is `queued` or `building`, and stop on close or unmount.
- **Ready-made image** selected: the existing `workspace-image` input, with the hint "Needs node 20+, git and glibc (not Alpine). Used instead of any recipe."
- **Save** (`workspace-settings-save`) sends the body for the selected source: `{ source: "global" }`, `{ source: "image", image: trimmed }` or `{ source: "recipe", recipe }`.
  - **Ready-made image with an empty input**: show the inline error "Enter an image, or choose Global recipe" and don't send.
  - **Success**: toast `Saved settings for `; when the answer's `build.state` is `queued` or `building`, toast `Saved settings for ; building its sandbox image` instead. Keep the drawer open when the saved source is `recipe` and a build was queued, so the user sees the log. Otherwise close as now.
  - **Failure**: show a 400 or 409 in `workspace-settings-error`, as now.

**Start run drawer** (`StartRunDrawer.tsx`):
- Extend `WorkspaceSettings` in `types.ts` to the new view shape (`source`, `recipe`, `dockerfile` and `effectiveImage` added).
- **Image line**: `sandboxImage` becomes `wsSettings?.effectiveImage || sandboxStatus?.defaultImage`.
- **Recipe workspace**: when `wsSettings.source === "recipe"`, fetch `GET /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/build` when the drawer opens, and poll it every 5 s (as the status poll at lines 176–193) while it is `queued` or `building`.
  - While `queued` or `building`, the switch is disabled with the reason `Building this workspace's sandbox image… (workspace settings)`.
  - When `failed`, the switch is disabled with `The workspace's sandbox image build failed (workspace settings)`.
- **Enabling the switch**: for a recipe workspace, the global image build doesn't matter. Enable it when its build is `ready` or `idle` and `sandboxStatus.available || sandboxStatus.building`. Otherwise keep the existing rule (`sandboxStatus.available`).
- Keep all existing test ids and texts for the global case.

**Test pattern:**
- `Workspaces.test.tsx`: `fakeApi` answers url and method from a table, `fireEvent.click(await screen.findByTestId("settings-github~octo~hello"))` opens the drawer, and `within(drawer)` is used for queries. Extend `fakeApi` with `wsSettings` (the full view), `globalSettings` (a `SandboxSettings`) and `wsBuild` (a `SandboxBuild` queue).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `WorkspaceSettings { sandbox: boolean; source: "global" | "recipe" | "image"; image: string | null; recipe: SandboxRecipe | null; dockerfile: string | null; effectiveImage: string; build?: SandboxBuild }`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxImage.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: export `BuildBadge`, and a small `BuildLog({ log, testId })` component with the auto-scroll logic, so both pages share them. Keep the existing test ids in Settings.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: as above.
- **GOTCHA**:
  - The drawer stays mounted between workspaces: reset all state when `workspace?.id` changes, as the effect at lines 19–44 does.
  - Every async setter checks an `alive` flag.
  - At 390 px the drawer is full width; the editor must not overflow.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: as above.

### UPDATE the tests
- **`Workspaces.test.tsx`**:
  - A new workspace opens with **Global recipe** checked and shows the global image.
  - Choosing **Own recipe** prefills the editor from the global recipe (`workspace-recipe-base` equals the global base).
  - Ticking `toolchain-java-enabled`, changing the base to `node:22-bookworm` and pressing Save PUTs `{ source: "recipe", recipe }` with java enabled and that base, and with a `queued` build in the answer shows `workspace-build-state` "queued".
  - **Copy global again** resets local edits.
  - **Ready-made image** with `python:3.12-bookworm` PUTs `{ source: "image", image: "python:3.12-bookworm" }`.
  - An empty ready-made image shows the inline error and sends nothing.
  - A 409 shows in `workspace-settings-error`.
  - Update the three existing drawer tests to the new flow: the image input is now behind **Ready-made image**, and a loaded `image` selects it.
- **`StartRunDrawer.test.tsx`**:
  - A recipe workspace with a `building` build has the switch disabled with `Building this workspace's sandbox image… (workspace settings)`.
  - With a `ready` build and `{ available: false, building: true }` global status, the switch is enabled and the image line shows `effectiveImage`.
  - Existing tests keep passing; give their `[SETTINGS]` answers `source: "global"` and an `effectiveImage`.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md`
- **IMPLEMENT**: rewrite "The sandbox images" to describe:
  - the Node-only default (`FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm`)
  - the 7 toolchains with their default snippets, one line each (checkbox, editable snippet, reset, order)
  - the extra lines and the live preview
  - the per-workspace source (global / own recipe / ready-made image), with "built on save; that workspace's sandboxed runs answer 409 until it is ready"
  - one build at a time, and cleanup
- Update the routes table: `GET/PUT /api/settings/sandbox` shape, `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile`, `GET/PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings` shape, `GET /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/build` and `POST /api/workspaces/:id/sandbox/rebuild`.
- Update the `GM_SANDBOX_IMAGE` row (line 56): "The base (Node) image of the default recipe".

### UPDATE `docs/wiki/features/sandboxes.md`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Replace the decisions "The recipe is base image + apt packages + extra Dockerfile lines…" and "The default recipe has Python, Java…" with rows from `docs/prd/sandbox-toolchains.md`'s Decisions table, with ticket "sandbox toolchains".
  - Add rows for the per-workspace source, the build queue, the verbatim lines (closes review F7), and the migration of old recipes.
  - In Known follow-ups, remove F7 and keep F5.
  - Add the new files to Code references (`RecipeEditor.tsx`, and the new routes).
  - Bump Last updated to 2026-11-08.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Workspaces → Settings shows a **Sandbox image** radio group: Global recipe (default, shows the global image), Own recipe and Ready-made image.
- [ ] Own recipe starts as a copy of the global recipe; the user can change the Node base image, tick toolchains, edit and reset snippets, reorder, and edit the extra lines, with a live Dockerfile preview. **Copy global again** restores the global copy.
- [ ] Save sends `{ source, … }`; a recipe save that queues a build keeps the drawer open and shows the badge (`queued` → `building …` → `ready`) and the log; **Rebuild** works; a failed build shows its error and log.
- [ ] Ready-made image saves `{ source: "image", image }`; an empty one is refused inline.
- [ ] Start run: for a workspace whose own image is building, **Run in sandbox** is disabled with `Building this workspace's sandbox image… (workspace settings)`; once ready, it is enabled and shows that workspace's image.
- [ ] README and `docs/wiki/features/sandboxes.md` describe the Node-only default, the toolchains and the per-workspace sources.
- [ ] No horizontal overflow at 390 px, in light and dark; all controls work with the keyboard.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx src/web/pages/SandboxCard.test.tsx
npm test -w graph-manager
```
